Use in this atlas

UNITID 130943 ↗

Carnegie classifications are descriptive metadata attached to IPEDS UNITID 130943. They are shown as published and do not enter the atlas peer-distance calculations. The institutional, research-activity, and student-access-and-earnings systems have separate methods and input periods.
